tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The site's blue (#1A76D1, its most-used colour). Buttons, active and hover nav, links, footer and copyright bands, icon hovers, dotted feature connectors. White text on it: 4.6:1.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Info-card blue (.single-schedule, #0a4784); matches the airport logo's ring. White text on it: 9:1.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, top-bar links, nav links at rest, and the dark 'Learn More' button fill (#2C2D3F). 13.5:1 on white.

tokens.name: text-dark
tokens.usage: Dark body copy where needed (#333). 12.6:1 on white.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body and secondary text: descriptions, section intros, captions (#707070). 5.0:1 on white, 4.7:1 on surface-alt and surface-card. Replaces the site's lighter #888, which failed AA.

tokens.name: text-menu
tokens.usage: Dropdown and mobile submenu links at rest (the site's #666). 5.7:1 on white.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page, header and top-bar ground.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Alternate light section ground (#f8f8f8).

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: News card ground (Bootstrap bg-light, #f8f9fa).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Top-bar bottom border, dashed dropdown dividers (#eee).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Feature icon circle outline (#ddd). Decorative only: 1.4:1, not a control border.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: Form field outlines (inputs, textareas, selects). 3.4:1 on white and 3.2:1 on surface-alt, so fields stay visible (WCAG 3:1 for control edges). Replaces the site's #eee field border.

tokens.name: primary-overlay
tokens.usage: Blue wash over photography, as on the Facts and Figures band (primary at 80%). White text on top.

tokens.name: logo-blue
tokens.usage: Company logo's main ink (star outer marks and the wordmark). Logo and brand graphics only. White text on it: 7.3:1.

tokens.name: logo-aqua
tokens.usage: Company logo's light aqua (the inner diamond marks). Logo and brand graphics only; never text (1.9:1 on white).

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Gold from the Karbala International Airport logo (dome, Arabic name). Logo only on the site; not a UI colour.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors (the site's Bootstrap danger). 4.5:1 with white.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: Hero headline (desktop), weight 400 in ink with the key word in primary. On phones the site sets it at 13px; see Hero.

styles.name: hero-subtitle
styles.usage: Hero subtitle under the headline, in ink, all breakpoints.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Counter numbers in the stats band, white.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: One of Iraq's largest infrastructure initiatives.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text size on the site.
styles.sample: Built to handle a wide range of aircraft.

styles.name: ar-hero
styles.usage: Arabic hero headline: same size as hero, line height 1.5 for Arabic ascenders and dots.

styles.name: ar-section-title
styles.usage: Arabic section headings; never capitalised or letter-spaced.

styles.name: ar-body
styles.usage: Arabic body text: taller leading than English body.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap; social icon gap.

tokens.name: space-15
tokens.usage: Top-bar padding; nav item gap.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Footer heading bottom padding; feature text gap.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: News card padding and tag inset (Bootstrap p-4).

tokens.name: space-25
tokens.usage: Button side padding; nav link vertical padding; copyright band padding.

tokens.name: space-30
tokens.usage: Info-card inner padding.

tokens.name: space-100
tokens.usage: Footer top band padding.

tokens.name: space-120
tokens.usage: Section vertical padding (.section).
